VAN.head: A steep climb for Vancouver
VAN.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games, Vancouver is playing for the second night in a row, and Vancouver has home ice. Vancouver’s best hope is getting good looks, plus a big night in goal.

VGK.head: This one sets up well for Vegas
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games, Vancouver is playing for the second night in a row, and Vancouver has home ice. Vancouver’s only real way in is getting good looks, and they would need a near-perfect night.

story.head: Round two in Vancouver
paras: The Golden Knights already came to Vancouver once this season and left with a 3-2 win. The Golden Knights come in at 2-1-0, the Canucks at 2-2-0.
